LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing 3.5 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Writing mechanics (spelling, word order)
Topic 3.6: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing 3.5 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Writing mechanics (spelling, word order) in Grade 6 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can we write an effective description?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. fill in a crossword puzzle with words related to food items and their tastes,

2. look at pictures with facial expressions and guess

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. fill in a crossword puzzle with words related to food items and their tastes,
2. look at pictures with facial expressions and guess

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Citizenship: Social cultural sensitivity and awareness is promoted when the learner understands, accepts and respects the

different tastes of food items from their community and around the world.

Values:
Unity: The learner appreciates the efforts of others when they work together to indicate if the sentences are punctuated

appropriately.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Intercultural awareness: This is promoted as the learner becomes aware of the various food items eaten in their community and

around the world.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner links their learning to Agriculture and Nutrition on the concept of different tastes of food.
